Text.description: Bounded nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

description: Search NIH-funded research projects in NIH RePORTER by topic, investigator, organization and fiscal year. Each row is one project's award for one fiscal year, so a project funded for five years gives five rows.

fiscal_year.description: One NIH fiscal year, such as 2025; all years by default.

investigator.description: Principal investigator, first and last name, such as "Pasi Janne"; partial names match more people.

limit.description: Ten project-years by default, one to fifty.

offset.description: Project-years to skip in RePORTER's order; RePORTER pages at most 15,000 deep.

organization.description: Funded organization name or part of it, as RePORTER spells it, such as "DANA-FARBER".

query.description: Words that must all appear in the project title, abstract or terms, such as "KRAS G12C".

title: GrantSearch
